description: This file defines the 'Session' class and related functions for managing browser sessions, including starting/stopping daemons, connecting via sockets, and handling session data within the Playwright core CLI client.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Manages browser session lifecycle, including compatibility checks, running commands, stopping, deleting data, and session configuration.

classes.name: SocketConnectionClient
classes.description: Handles socket communication with the browser session, sending messages, receiving responses, and managing callbacks.

methods.name: renderResolvedConfig
methods.description: Generates a human-readable configuration summary for a given session configuration.
